    Constructor for ECTermScoring Objects

    ECTermScoring.Rd

    Creates an ECTermScoring object from a data frame or file.

    ECTermScoring(term_element_edges, col_term = 1, col_element = 2, ...)

    Arguments

    term_element_edges

    A data frame or path to a file. Needs two columns: one for term IDs and one for element IDs, representing membership. If a file path, it's assumed to be tab-separated with a header by default.

    col_term

    The name or index of the column containing term IDs (in `term_element_edges`). Defaults to 1.

    col_element

    The name or index of the column containing element IDs (in `term_element_edges`). Defaults to 2.

    ...

    Additional arguments passed to `utils::read.table` if `term_element_edges` is a file path (e.g., `sep`, `header`).

    Value

    An object of class ECTermScoring.

    See also

    Primary analysis functions:

    • terms_ecset_statistics: Score terms against a single set of elements.

    • terms_ecset_statistics_fdr: Wrapper for single-set scoring with Empirical FDR correction.

    • run_vsea: Perform Vertex Set Enrichment Analysis (VSEA) on a ranked list of elements.

    • terms_ecranks_statistics: Calculate raw enrichment profiles for ranked lists.

    FDR and Vectorized functions:

    • calculate_ecset_fdr: Calculate Empirical FDR for single-set enrichment results.

    • terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized: Efficiently score terms against multiple element sets.

    Graph management and Utilities:

    • trim_bipartite_terms: Trim high-degree terms to improve fast approximation suitability.

    • remove_isolated_elements: Remove elements with no term connections.

    • remove_empty_terms: Remove terms with no element connections.

    • reduce_universe_by_elements: Filter the graph to a specific set of elements.

    • reduce_universe_by_terms: Filter the graph to a specific set of terms.

    • summarize_suitability_bipartite: Check graph suitability for fast approximation.

    • to_dataframe: Convert the bipartite graph to a data frame edge list.

    • show: Summary display of the object.

    Underlying graph classes: ECGraph, ECProb

    Examples

    # Create a sample term-element membership data frame
te_df <- data.frame(
   term = c("TermA", "TermA", "TermB", "TermC", "TermC"),
   element = c("Elem1", "Elem2", "Elem2", "Elem3", "Elem4")
)

# Create an ECTermScoring object
ects <- ECTermScoring(te_df)
print(ects@terms)
#> [1] "TermA" "TermB" "TermC"
print(ects@elements)
#> [1] "Elem1" "Elem2" "Elem3" "Elem4"
